boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase activities at UAH and around Huntsville, each supported by a current public source.

cards.title: Settle in at Salmon Library
cards.subtitle: UAH campus
cards.notes: Meet in the library lobby, check in if you are a guest, then choose a floor to read, study, or catch up between classes.
cards.short_summary: A campus library hang with no charge to enter.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH states that community members may come to Salmon Library to read or study and that there is no charge to enter.
cards.source_title: Non-UAH Patrons: Community, Local Education, and Guest Access at the M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.access_notes: Guests check in at the User Services Desk; guest entry is from opening until 8 p.m. or 15 minutes before closing, whichever is earlier.

cards.title: Browse the physical collection
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library, UAH
cards.notes: Pick a shelf or map case together and browse print books, journals, maps, or special collections without checking anything out.
cards.short_summary: An in-building browse session using UAH’s print collection.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says community members without guest access may view the library’s physical books, journals, maps, and special collections, with no charge to enter.
cards.source_title: Non-UAH Patrons: Community, Local Education, and Guest Access at the M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.access_notes: Use materials in the building and follow library and campus policies; guests must check in at the User Services Desk.

cards.title: Look up a government document
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library, UAH
cards.notes: Use the special kiosk to pull up a government document, then compare what you find and save a topic for a later research session.
cards.short_summary: A focused research stop using the library’s public government-documents kiosk.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says community members without guest access can use a special kiosk at Salmon Library to look up government documents, and entry is free.
cards.source_title: Non-UAH Patrons: Community, Local Education, and Guest Access at the M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.access_notes: Ask library staff for government-documents kiosk information; guests must check in at the User Services Desk.

cards.title: Ride the Friday Night UAH Shuttle
cards.subtitle: Charger Village, Central Campus, North Campus, and off-campus stops
cards.notes: Bring a valid UAH student ID and use the Friday evening route to ride together between campus, Target, Walmart, and Bridge Street Centre.
cards.short_summary: A student-ID ride for reaching campus and nearby stops on Friday evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH states that students ride the Friday Night UAH Shuttle free with a valid student ID.
cards.access_notes: The route runs Fridays except holidays; UAH lists a 5:00 p.m. start at Charger Village and a 10:10 p.m. final return.

cards.title: Follow the Downtown Art Essentials Tour
cards.subtitle: Downtown Huntsville public-art sites
cards.notes: Download the self-guided tour resource, choose a few stops, and take a slow walking loop through the documented public artworks downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Arts Huntsville provides downloadable self-guided public-art tour resources and describes the Downtown Art Essentials Tour as a self-guided adventure in public places.
cards.access_notes: Download the guide before leaving; this is a self-guided walk through public places.

cards.entity_name: Visitor Center's Lucky Duck Scavenger Hunt
cards.title: Find the Lucky Duck sculptures
cards.subtitle: Downtown Huntsville public-art sites
cards.notes: Get the clue card online and split up the hints as you look for Everett Cox’s bronze ducks near downtown public-art locations.
cards.short_summary: A free scavenger hunt built around named bronze duck sculptures.
cards.evidence_claim: Arts Huntsville calls the Visitor Center’s Lucky Duck Scavenger Hunt free and says participants can get clue cards online.
cards.access_notes: Use the online clue cards and follow the self-guided route in public areas.

cards.title: Walk Aldridge Creek Greenway
cards.subtitle: Huntsville greenway route toward Ditto Landing
cards.notes: Choose a turnaround point before you start, then walk, bike, roll, or stroll beside the creek and regroup at the end.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost greenway outing along Aldridge Creek.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville lists Aldridge Creek Greenway among its trails and greenways and says walking, biking, rolling, or strolling on a City greenway has no cost.
cards.source_title: 5 free Huntsville resources for a stronger, healthier you
cards.access_notes: Use the greenway for walking, biking, rolling, or strolling; bring water and use care around changing weather.

cards.title: Stroll Flint River Greenway
cards.subtitle: Huntsville greenway along the Flint River
cards.notes: Plan a daylight walk with a friend and use the river setting as the reason to slow down, talk, and take a few photos.
cards.short_summary: A river-side greenway walk without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville lists Flint River Greenway among its trails and greenways and says walking, biking, rolling, or strolling on a City greenway has no cost.
cards.source_title: 5 free Huntsville resources for a stronger, healthier you
cards.access_notes: Use the greenway for walking, biking, rolling, or strolling; plan around daylight and weather conditions.

cards.title: Take a Wade Mountain Greenway walk
cards.subtitle: Huntsville trail and greenway network
cards.notes: Set an easy pace on the unpaved route, pause for a group photo, and turn back well before daylight or weather becomes a concern.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville identifies Wade Mountain Greenway as a hiking option and says its City greenways and trails can be used with no cost.
cards.source_title: 5 free Huntsville resources for a stronger, healthier you
cards.access_notes: The City describes this as a route to leave pavement behind; use suitable footwear and plan for daylight and weather.

cards.entity_name: Dr. Richard Showers, Sr. Splash Pad
cards.title: Cool off at the Showers Splash Pad
cards.subtitle: 4600 Blue Springs Road NW, Huntsville
cards.notes: Bring a towel, meet at the shaded benches, and use the splash pad during posted hours; nearby tables make an easy regrouping spot.
cards.short_summary: A city splash pad with explicitly free use.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville states that the Dr. Richard Showers, Sr. Splash Pad is free to use.
cards.source_title: Dr. Richard Showers, Sr. Splash Pad
cards.access_notes: The City lists current hours as Monday through Saturday, 10 a.m.–7 p.m.; anyone under 16 must be accompanied by a family member age 16 or older.
